# FavGrab

> Free browser-based toolkit for web developers. Download favicons from any domain, and convert images between PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, TIFF, BMP, and ICO — entirely client-side, with no uploads.

FavGrab runs as a single-page application. All image processing happens in the visitor's browser using Canvas, WebCodecs, and lazy-loaded WebAssembly codecs (libheif-js for HEIC/HEIF, utif2 for TIFF, @jsquash/avif for AVIF encode). No file ever leaves the user's device. There is no account, no analytics tracking individual users, and no paid tier.

## Tools

- [Favicon Downloader](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/): Enter any domain, get its favicon at sizes 16, 32, 48, 64, 128, or 256 pixels. Export as PNG, WebP, or JPG. Powered by Google's FaviconV2 service as the upstream source.
- [Image Converter](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert): Drop one or more images. Decode formats: PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF, GIF (first frame), BMP, ICO, HEIC, HEIF, TIFF. Encode formats: PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF, BMP, ICO. Supports per-file quality (1–100) for lossy outputs, optional max-side resize with aspect preserved, and batch download as a streaming ZIP.

## Conversion guides

Static, no-JS landing pages explaining a specific conversion. Each links into the live converter.

- [Image Converter — hub](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/image-converter): Overview of every supported conversion, both directions, with links to each guide.
- [HEIC to JPG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/heic-to-jpg): Turn iPhone HEIC photos into universal JPG files.
- [HEIC to PNG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/heic-to-png): Convert iPhone HEIC images to lossless PNG.
- [WebP to PNG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/webp-to-png): Save downloaded .webp images as standard PNG, transparency preserved.
- [PNG to WebP](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/png-to-webp): Compress PNG to lightweight WebP for faster sites.
- [PNG to JPG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/png-to-jpg): Shrink PNG files to compact JPG with quality control.
- [JPG to PNG](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/jpg-to-png): Convert JPG/JPEG to lossless PNG for editing.
- [PNG to ICO](https://favgrab.boldkit.dev/convert/png-to-ico): Generate a favicon.ico or Windows icon from a PNG.
